skill.name: data-engineer
skill.description: Build scalable data pipelines, modern data warehouses, and real-time streaming architectures with Spark, dbt, Airflow, and cloud data platforms.
skill.summary: Design reliable batch, streaming, warehouse, and lakehouse data systems.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by line 45 listing real-time analytics engines, not system reconnaissance behavior. The skill contains descriptive guidance for data engineering architecture and operations, with no scripts, network calls, credential access, or prompt injection evidence.

static_findings.snippet: - Real-time analytics with Apache Pinot, ClickHouse, Apache Druid

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 45 lists Apache Pinot, ClickHouse, and Apache Druid as analytics technologies. This is descriptive capability text, not host inspection, command execution, or system reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Data teams need pipelines that meet scale, latency, quality, and governance goals. This skill guides architecture, orchestration, validation, and operations.
actual_capabilities: Designs batch and streaming pipeline architectures for cloud and open source stacks.
Recommends warehouse, lakehouse, and data lake patterns for analytics workloads.
Plans orchestration with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, and cloud workflow services.
Defines data quality checks, lineage, governance, and monitoring requirements.
Reviews performance, cost, partitioning, clustering, and scaling tradeoffs.
limitations: Does not connect to data sources or deploy infrastructure by itself.
Requires user-provided requirements, constraints, and platform details.
Outputs still need environment-specific testing and security review.
Does not replace compliance, privacy, or production operations ownership.

use_cases.title: Plan a Modern Data Platform
use_cases.description: Design a warehouse, lakehouse, or modern data stack with ingestion, transformation, serving, and governance layers.

use_cases.title: Improve Pipeline Reliability
use_cases.description: Add validation, monitoring, lineage, retries, and operational runbooks to existing data pipelines.

use_cases.title: Select Streaming Architecture
use_cases.description: Compare Kafka, Flink, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, and related services for low-latency event processing.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Pipeline Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to recommend a batch or streaming pipeline pattern for my use case. Include sources, transformations, storage, orchestration, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Warehouse Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a warehouse model for these business questions, source tables, data freshness needs, and reporting constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Data Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my pipeline design for failure modes, data quality risks, cost issues, and missing operational controls.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Cloud Data Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a multi-cloud data platform with ingestion, lakehouse storage, transformations, governance, security, observability, and disaster recovery.

output_examples.input: Design a Kafka to BigQuery streaming pipeline for product events.
output_examples.output: A recommended architecture with Kafka topics, schema registry, stream processing, dead-letter handling, BigQuery partitioning, monitoring, and recovery steps.

output_examples.input: Improve our nightly dbt and Airflow pipeline reliability.
output_examples.output: A reliability plan covering dependency checks, source freshness, dbt tests, retry policies, alert routing, lineage updates, and runbook ownership.

output_examples.input: Choose between Snowflake, BigQuery, and Redshift for analytics.
output_examples.output: A decision matrix describing workload fit, cost controls, ecosystem integration, governance features, performance concerns, and migration risks.

best_practices: Provide source systems, expected volume, latency targets, data owners, and compliance constraints.
Ask for validation, monitoring, lineage, and rollback plans with each pipeline design.
Review cost and operational complexity before selecting managed services or open source tools.
anti_patterns: Do not request production deployment steps without platform access controls and approval paths.
Do not skip data contracts, schema evolution, or quality checks for critical datasets.
Do not treat high-level architecture advice as a substitute for load testing.

faq.question: Can this skill write data pipeline code?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation patterns and structure, but generated code must be reviewed, tested, and adapted to your environment.

faq.question: Does this skill support cloud data platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, and common open source data tools.

faq.question: Can it help with streaming systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It can design event pipelines with Kafka, Flink, Pulsar, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, and related services.

faq.question: Can it review existing architecture?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide diagrams, pipeline steps, service choices, and pain points for a focused review.

faq.question: Does it handle data governance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for lineage, catalogs, access control, privacy, masking, and compliance planning.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive data?
faq.answer: Do not paste secrets or regulated records. Share schemas, requirements, and anonymized examples when possible.
